question:
Figures 1-4 are four tiles cut from one aerial photograph along a 2x2 grid, given in scrambled order. Each candidate below assigns the figures to grid positions, written as [top-left, top-right; bottom-left, bottom-right]. At most one assignment reassembles the original photograph with all roads and field boundaries continuous across the seams. Which one?
(A) figures [1, 2; 4, 3]
(B) figures [4, 1; 2, 3]
(C) figures [3, 4; 2, 1]
(D) None of the assignments reassembles the photograph correctly.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
